
```{python}
import sorobn as hh
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error, mean_absolute_error, mean_absolute_percentage_error
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import pandas as pd

import plotly.express as px
import plotly.io as pio
pio.templates.default = "plotly_white"
```

```{python}
breast = pd.read_csv("data/breast-cancer.data",names=['class', 'age', 'menopause', 'tumor-size', 'inv-nodes', 'node-caps', 'deg-malig', 'breast', 'breast-quad', 'irradiat'])
breast = breast.drop(['node-caps','breast-quad'],axis=1)
```

```{python}
#features = ['class', 'age', 'menopause', 'tumor-size', 'inv-nodes', 'node-caps', 'breast', 'breast-quad', 'irradiat']
target = 'class'
features = ['deg-malig', 'age', 'menopause', 'tumor-size', 'inv-nodes', 'breast', 'irradiat']
breast_all = pd.get_dummies(breast, columns = features)
```

---

```{python}
breast_train, breast_test = train_test_split(breast_all, random_state=0, test_size=0.5)
```


```{python}
model = DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=3).fit(
    X=breast_train[breast_train.columns[1:]],
    y=breast_train[target])
```

```{python}
test_predictions = model.predict(breast_test[breast_test.columns[1:]])
accuracy_score(
    y_true=breast_test[target],
    y_pred=test_predictions
)
```


---

```{python}
structure = hh.structure.chow_liu(breast)
bn = hh.BayesNet(*structure)
bn = bn.fit(breast)
dot = bn.graphviz()
print(dot.source)
```
```{python}
predictions=[]
for i in breast_test.to_dict('records'):
  del i[target]
  predictions.append(bn.query(target, event=i).idxmax())
```

```{python}
accuracy_score(
    y_true=breast_test[target],
    y_pred=predictions
)
```
See how sure it was about the correct prediction

```{python}
certainty = {"no-recurrence-events":[],"recurrence-events":[]}
for i in breast.to_dict('records'):
  correct = i.pop(target)
  certainty[correct].append(bn.query(target, event=i)[correct])
for guess in certainty.keys():
  print(guess, pd.Series(certainty[guess]).mean())
```
